∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing.{u_1} k] (n : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype.{u_2} n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} n],
  Eq.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)} (Etingof.commutatorSubmodule.{u_1, max u_1 u_2} k (Matrix.{u_2, u_2, u_1} n n k))
    (LinearMap.ker.{u_1, u_1, max u_1 u_2, u_1} (Matrix.traceLinearMap.{u_2, u_1, u_1} n k k))

∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing.{u_1} k] (d : Nat),
  Eq.{u_1 + 1} (Etingof.commutatorSubmodule.{u_1, u_1} k (Matrix.{0, 0, u_1} (Fin d) (Fin d) k))
    (LinearMap.ker.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_1} (Matrix.traceLinearMap.{0, u_1, u_1} (Fin d) k k))
